prompt:
Transform this exact 3x3 reference contact sheet into a polished children's game BLUEPRINT CARD SHEET. Nine items, same order, same silhouettes, composition, orientation and viewing angles as the reference. Keep each item immediately recognizable. This is a rendering-style conversion, not a redesign.

OUTPUT: square 3x3 grid of NINE equal rounded-corner blueprint cards, ideally 1800x1800. Generous consistent gutters between cards and around sheet, about 5% card width. Transparent space outside cards. Each card is solid deep teal-blue close to #2b6a80 with an extremely faint, regular fine square graph-paper grid clipped inside the rounded card. All cards same size and color. No card drop shadows. Objects centered with ample card padding.

OBJECT RENDERING CRITICAL: ONLY thin clean uniform WHITE and PALE SKY-BLUE LINE ART. No colored surfaces, no solid white-filled object areas, no grey fills, no shading, no gradients, no glow. Object faces are transparent/unfilled so the blue card/grid remains visible through them. Thin lines trace recognizable outer silhouettes and the minimum necessary internal details, like an elegant simplified blueprint illustration for children. Light white primary contours and pale blue details, same thin line weight everywhere. No hatch shading, no mesh, no complex machinery diagrams, no cross sections, no exploded views.
Add only 1-3 small restrained measurement arrows or short dimension guide lines outside each item, without any labels, letters or numbers. Keep those marks subtle. Objects remain the main focus. NO TEXT of any kind, no headings, captions, numerals, letters or fake glyphs.

Exact content/order from reference:
Top-left: round low smart speaker with oval top ring and one small pill-shaped button, same domed shape and angle.
Top-middle: wheelchair, same 3/4 angle, handles, backrest, seat, armrests, large rear wheels/spokes, small front casters and footrests. Preserve visible wheel arrangement.
Top-right: compact rounded self-driving car, same front three-quarter orientation, roof sensor puck, windows, headlights and wheels.
Middle-left: tilted smartphone call translator with globe screen icon and two speech bubbles on either side, same tilt and placement. Globe and bubbles line art only.
Middle-center: four-rotor pest drone above the same broad leaf with a tiny bug and corner brackets. Preserve drone-above-leaf arrangement. Everything including bug is outlined pale line art.
Middle-right: box-shaped delivery robot with wheels, cheerful face display, rooftop sensor and parcel, same three-quarter angle. Trace parcel tape bands and display face with thin lines, no filled eyes.
Bottom-left: passenger drone taxi, same cabin silhouette, cockpit outline, four circular rotor shrouds and landing skids at same angle.
Bottom-middle: tilted phone with face scanning symbol and open padlock at its lower right, same layout. Face icon simple lines, lock keyhole outlined rather than filled.
Bottom-right: small greenhouse with pitched glass roof, front door, sprouts inside and small external control box, same orientation and perspective.

All nine drawn as charming simple cartoon BLUEPRINTS, no original cream/green/red/yellow object colors. Fine white/pale-blue lines on dark teal graph-paper cards, airy 3x3 layout with generous gutters, no text.
